hero.h1: Faucet Repair and Installation in Hinsdale, IL
hero.sub: A dripping kitchen faucet, a bath faucet that won't shut off or a new set of fixtures for a remodel. We repair and install faucets and fixtures carefully, around stone counters and custom finishes. Our office is on Spinning Wheel Road.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in branded red leather gloves installing a new chrome faucet on a white bathroom sink with an adjustable wrench

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

tiles.body: A leaking supply line or connection.
Mineral buildup or a failing cartridge.

bodies: We repair and install every kind of kitchen faucet, from pull-down and touchless models to pot fillers and bar faucets. We work carefully around stone counters and undermount sinks.
Many premium faucets can be rebuilt with factory parts. If yours can, we'll tell you before recommending a replacement.

Beyond the faucet, we handle the rest of the kitchen: drains, shutoff valves, dishwasher and refrigerator connections, instant hot water dispensers and [garbage disposals](/hinsdale/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).
Remodeling? We can move or add plumbing for an island, a prep sink or a pot filler.

img.alt: Plumbing under a double kitchen sink: white PVC drain and P-trap, braided supply lines with chrome shutoff valves, and a garbage disposal

bodies: We install sinks, faucets, toilets, showerheads and body sprays throughout the house and check the shutoffs and supply lines while we're there.
Replacing several fixtures at once? We'll plan it so it's done in as few visits as possible.

blocks.h2: Faucets and Fixtures in Hinsdale Homes
blocks.intro: Hinsdale homes often have high-end fixtures and older plumbing behind them.

items.body: Many quality brands sell replacement cartridges and parts.
Valves under sinks in older homes can seize. We replace them when we replace the fixture.
We work carefully to protect the finish.
Secondary sinks often have their own faucets and drains that need the same care as the kitchen.

items.q: Can you repair a high-end faucet instead of replacing it?
items.answer: Often. Many premium faucets have replacement cartridges and parts available. We'll tell you if yours can be rebuilt.

items.q: Can you install fixtures we bought ourselves?
items.answer: Yes. We install fixtures you've purchased, as long as all the parts are included.

items.q: Can you add a pot filler?
items.answer: Yes. We run a water line to the wall behind the range and install the pot filler.

items.q: Do you replace old shutoff valves?
items.answer: Yes. We replace seized or leaking shutoffs, usually while working on the fixture.

items.q: Can you install an instant hot water dispenser?
items.answer: Yes. We install the tank under the sink and the dispenser faucet, and connect it to power and water.

items.q: How much does faucet repair cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet and what's wrong. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
